leads_to.evidence: A BSW is the usual requirement for entry-level nonclinical social work jobs. Clinical social workers need an MSW, supervised experience and a state license. BSW graduates can often finish an MSW a year early through advanced standing.

nearby_pair.evidence: Both Ana G. Méndez campuses are traditional undergraduate campuses with a CSWE-accredited social work bachelor's, and Cupey posts licensure disclosures for its program, so a new student could choose either one.

school_matters.evidence: Selective schools pay no more than open ones in this major. Most BSW graduates take nonclinical jobs in agencies and government, where the pay depends on the employer's scale, not on which school a graduate attended.

who_is_counted.evidence: I found no list of the largest BSW programs or their admission rules. ASU's online BSW, aimed at adults, only started in 2024, so it is not yet in these graduates' numbers.

programs.evidence: Berkeley admits a small share of applicants, and its graduates earn more than those of other schools in a major where selectivity usually changes pay very little.
